Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: You did not have to say it like that !

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: But I understand. Well, I wish a good life for you.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: Not that it matters, but this is the last time you'll see him. You didn't think that 'identity crisis' was a tree species, but you're surely glad to be finally rid of him.
